notes.title: Retro Rally Major Update
notes.content:
[h2][h1][b]What's new in this update?[/b]
[/h1][/h2]

- New physics

- New visuals

- New cars added

- Added new maps

- New UI

- 5 new music added

- [b]Controller support[/b]

- new sounds have been added to the vehicles

- you will now be able to see the technical specifications of the vehicles in the purchase menu

[h1][b]Technical Specifications Added to the Menu[/b][/h1]

- Top Speed
- Engine Torque
- Break Torque
- Gear
- Turbo Charge
- Downforce
- Traction

These features affect the driving and prices of vehicles

- You can now turn on the slow motion mode with the G key

- There are 5 camera angles available

- Now you can set the car automatically or manually from the gameplay section in the pause menu inside the game

- There are different sections such as forest, palm trees, autumn weather, mountain driving, some sections are long, some sections are short, and the earnings are determined according to it

-[b]Bugs fixed[/b]
